text:
sarah: Heads up — dashboard widgets are returning empty rows for some users after yesterday's RBAC pushdown. Seen in QA and staging. Anyone else?
jordan: Repro'd on my account. Filters that used tenant_ids IN (...) are rewritten into joins, planner picks bad nested-loop plan, queries time out.
lee: Right — we moved RBAC checks into the projection layer per the RFC. Tradeoff was fewer round trips but bigger fanouts at DB time.
mike: I looked at the plan. We're adding an EXISTS(subquery) per row: SELECT ... WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM perms WHERE perms.user_id = $1 AND perms.res_id = t.res_id). Planner chooses nested loop for many cases.
anya: Options: 1) revert pushdown -> app-side filter (more fetches). 2) keep pushdown but add prefiltered materialized view keyed by tenant set. 3) hybrid: route high-cardinality tenant queries to app, low-cardinality to DB.
sarah: Need short-term rollback gating. Can we flip a feature flag per-tenant? :thinking_face:
lee: Yes. Runtime routing flag is feasible. Dedicated customers already have per-tenant config. For hosted, default to DB pushdown and fallback to app-filter on timeout.
mike: Quick perf snapshot: tenant_cardinality > 50 -> app-side 2.4x faster. tenant_cardinality < 5 -> DB pushdown 3x faster. So hybrid + thresholding seems best.
jordan: Also possible: precompute allowed resource lists for active sessions and intersect client-side to avoid joins. Cache hit would be instant.
anya: Precompute has memory & staleness concerns. Need TTL + invalidation on permission changes (and audit hooks).
sarah: Action items: mike -> feature flag + rollback playbook; jordan -> prototype permission cache; lee -> update RFC with hybrid routing + cost heuristic; ops-bot -> add watch + auto-fallback after 3 consecutive query timeouts.
ops-bot: deployed rollout-gate v1 to staging :white_check_mark:
mike: I'll open the PR tonight. Adding a circuit-breaker: if DB latency >500ms for 5 consecutive queries, fallback to app-filter.
jordan: Sketch for routing threshold:
```
if tenant_count > 20:
  route = app_filter
else:
  route = db_pushdown
```
Tune threshold after load tests.
anya: SG. Let's do a 30-min sync tomorrow 10:00 to pick approach and owner for the materialized view design.
sarah: Marking this P1 for console availability. I'll post a short playbook in #incidents and ping customers if we roll back. Thanks all. :pray:
